preconditions.description: N and Q are within the specified range.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= L[i] <= R[i] <= N for i in range(N))
preconditions.description: Each pair (L[i], R[i]) satisfies the column range constraint.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= N and 1 <= y <= N for x, y in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query (x, y) satisfies the row and column range constraint.

postconditions.description: The number of output lines matches the number of queries.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i] in ['E', 'O'] for i in range(Q))
postconditions.description: Each output line is either 'E' or 'O'.

postconditions.expression: output[i] == ('E' if (sum(matrix[x-1][y-1] for x, y in queries) % 2 == 0) else 'O') for i in range(Q)
postconditions.description: The parity of the sum of the matrix after removing the specified rows and columns matches the output.
